name: After § 13
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text: 13a. Urges the EU to avoid policies that could be perceived as interference in Georgia’s domestic politics and maintain a neutral and constructive approach in order to avoid geopolitical tensions, particularly with regard to Georgia’s balance of relations with the EU and other international partners, including Russia;
